def factor_volume_momentum_simple(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], 20)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_momentum_simple"] = momentum * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_momentum_simple"]
description: Simplification of parent: removes the range compression modifier and replaces manual volume ratio with alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime EMA-based ratio. The core mechanism is momentum amplified by volume conviction: high momentum with high relative volume suggests strong conviction. This single mechanism is more interpretable and expected to reduce noise, potentially improving IC and information ratio while preserving rank stability.
